name: scroll-flyover
title_zh: 滚动即飞行，纯代码生成 3D 场景页
tagline_zh: 不用 Midjourney 不用视频生成，滚动滚轮就是一段无缝飞越。真实 3D 相机沿样条线穿行。
tagline_en: No AI image/video bills. Scroll = camera flying a spline through procedural scenes. Drop in your own photos as.
desc_en: Build a scroll-scrubbed "fly through the world" landing page using LIVE Three.js/WebGL — NO paid AI image/video generation, zero per-build cost. A real 3D camera flies a continuous spline through procedurally-built scenes as the user scrolls, no cuts; the user's own photos can optionally be dropped in as textured props. Interviews for topic, story beats, and palette, then generates a self-containe
why_zh: 把滚动条变成摄影机轨道，全程程序化生成，零 API 费用。每次滚动都是一次新运镜。
why_en: Scrollbar becomes a camera track. Fully procedural, zero per-build cost. Every scroll is live 3D, not a pre-rendered video.
limit_zh: 只产出单页滚动体验，不接多页路由；需要浏览器支持 WebGL2；照片贴图需用户自备且授权。
limit_en: Single-page scroll only, no multi-route. Needs WebGL2. User supplies own photos & rights. No complex narrative or character animation.
